profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stealth Startup
profile.summary:
Hello, my name is Raj Patel. 

I was born in India and moved to the United States in 2010. Since then, I have loved computers. This led me to the decision of pursuing a Computer Science Degree at the University of Washington. I am currently a direct admit in the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science and Engineering. I am also pursuing a Minor in Business.

I am currently pursuing a future career in Software Development and have a lot of expertise in multiple programming languages like Java, C, SQL, etc. I am also very knowledgeable in Object Oriented Programming and working with different data structures as well as AI. 

Outside of school, I love to play sports, ride my bike, and go exploring. I am also in a lot of clubs and RSOs. In addition, I also love to volunteer and have accumulated over 500 hours of community service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Founded and built AI-driven developer productivity applications and browser extensions supporting developers.
• Architected and implemented core systems using JavaScript/React and GenAI APIs; owned full SDLC including design, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), deployment, and iteration.
• Monitored production health, resolved issues, and ensured secure API integrations and data handling.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Engineering · Web Engineering · Software Industry · Software Infrastructure · Project Management · JavaScript · React.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · GenAI API Extensions

positions.title: Technical Operations Manager
positions.locationName: Walla Walla, Washington, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Administered property systems using AutoClerk PMS, managing reservations, billing workflows, reporting, and system configuration.
• Served as primary on-site technical lead; troubleshot network, POS, printer, and workstation issues; performed system configuration and vendor-coordinated escalations.
• Designed and deployed a custom internal software solution to log employee hours and automate payroll reporting, improving data accuracy and reducing manual processing.
• Analyzed operational and revenue data to support system optimization and process efficiency improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Business · Lodging · Hospitality Management · Hotel Management · Technical Operations · Property Management Systems

positions.title: Specialist
positions.description:
• Provided structured troubleshooting and technical support for iOS and macOS devices, isolating software and configuration issues through systematic diagnostics.
• Guided customers through secure device setup workflows including data migration, authentication, and account configuration.
• Enforced customer data protection and company security policies during troubleshooting — used authorized imaging tools, sanitized devices, and anonymized telemetry before sharing with internal teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing · Sales Management · Customer Service · Communication · Sales Operations

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Managed structured data workflows and financial records using Microsoft 365.
• Performed data validation, reconciliation, and budget tracking to ensure reporting accuracy and compliance.
• Provided technical support for office systems and optimized administrative processes for reliability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Inventory Management · Account Management · Quality Management · Communication · Data Entry · Microsoft Office

company.name: Seattle Molecular and Cellular Biology Program

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.locationName: Walla Walla, Washington, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Managed and assessed property. 
• Responsible for overseeing the successful operations of a lodging facility to ensure excellent service to guests. 
• Duties included managing and staffing front office, budgets, housekeeping, and resolving guest concerns. 
• In my roles, I undertook responsibilities such as welcoming and assisting customers, laundering bedding and cleaning rooms, and swiftly addressing any property-related issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Business · Sales · Lodging · Hospitality Management · Customer Service · Hotel Management · Communication

volunteerExperiences.description: Successfully collected over 250 pounds of food to donate to the local food bank in Walla Walla, WA.
Contributed over 350 hours organizing, shelving books, assisting in special events, and aided patrons seeking in locating additional library resources.
